content.short: Friend.tech is a revolutionary decentralized social platform enabling users to tokenize their social influence.
content.description: Friend.tech is a pioneering decentralized social application that allows users to buy and sell 'shares' (keys) of their favorite creators and influencers. By tokenizing social influence, Friend.tech creates a new marketplace for social capital, where shares provide exclusive access to private chat rooms and direct interaction with creators. The platform leverages the speed and low cost of Layer 2 networks to provide a seamless mobile-first experience, fostering a more direct and rewarding relationship between influencers and their communities. Friend.tech is a leading force in the 'SocialFi' movement, redefining the boundaries of social interaction and digital value creation in the Web3 era.
content.meta: Friend.tech is the leading SocialFi platform, empowering users to tokenize social influence and interact directly with creators in Web3.
